verses.original: אַ֣לְלַי לִ֗י כִּ֤י הָיִ֙יתִי֙ כְּאָסְפֵּי־ קַ֔יִץ כְּעֹלְלֹ֖ת בָּצִ֑יר אֵין־ אֶשְׁכּ֣וֹל לֶאֱכ֔וֹל בִּכּוּרָ֖ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃ אִוְּתָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: ’al·lay lî kî hā·yî·ṯî kə·’ā·sə·pê- qa·yiṣ kə·‘ō·lə·lōṯ bā·ṣîr ’ên- ’eš·kō·wl le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl bik·kū·rāh nap̄·šî ’iw·wə·ṯāh
verses.literal: Woe is me For I am like one gathering summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard there [is no] cluster to eat no early fig that I crave

verses.original: חָסִיד֙ אָבַ֤ד מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אָ֑יִן וְיָשָׁ֥ר בָּאָדָ֖ם כֻּלָּם֙ יֶאֱרֹ֔בוּ לְדָמִ֣ים יָצ֥וּדוּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ אָחִ֖יהוּ חֵֽרֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·sîḏ ’ā·ḇaḏ min- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ā·yin wə·yā·šār bā·’ā·ḏām kul·lām ye·’ĕ·rō·ḇū lə·ḏā·mîm yā·ṣū·ḏū ’îš ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥî·hū ḥê·rem
verses.literal: The godly [man] has perished from the earth there is no one upright among men They all lie in wait for blood they hunt one - another with a net

verses.original: עַל־ כַּפַּ֙יִם֙ לְהֵיטִ֔יב הָרַ֤ע הַשַּׂ֣ר וְהַשֹּׁפֵ֖ט שֹׁאֵ֔ל בַּשִׁלּ֑וּם וְהַגָּד֗וֹל דֹּבֵ֨ר ה֖וּא הַוַּ֥ת נַפְשׁ֛וֹ וַֽיְעַבְּתֽוּהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kap·pa·yim lə·hê·ṭîḇ hā·ra‘ haś·śar wə·haš·šō·p̄êṭ šō·’êl ba·šil·lūm wə·hag·gā·ḏō·wl dō·ḇêr hū haw·waṯ nap̄·šōw way·‘ab·bə·ṯū·hā
verses.literal: - Both hands are skilled at evil the prince and the judge demand a bribe When the powerful utters his evil desire they all conspire together

verses.original: טוֹבָ֣ם כְּחֵ֔דֶק יָשָׁ֖ר מִמְּסוּכָ֑ה י֤וֹם מְצַפֶּ֙יךָ֙ בָ֔אָה פְּקֻדָּתְךָ֣ עַתָּ֥ה תִהְיֶ֖ה מְבוּכָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·w·ḇām kə·ḥê·ḏeq yā·šār mim·mə·sū·ḵāh yō·wm mə·ṣap·pe·ḵā ḇā·’āh pə·qud·dā·ṯə·ḵā ‘at·tāh ṯih·yeh mə·ḇū·ḵā·ṯām
verses.literal: The best of them [is] like a brier the most upright [is sharper] than a hedge of thorns The day for your watchmen has come [the day of] your visitation Now is [the time] of their confusion

verses.original: אַל־ תַּאֲמִ֣ינוּ בְרֵ֔עַ אַֽל־ תִּבְטְח֖וּ בְּאַלּ֑וּף שְׁמֹ֖ר פִּתְחֵי־ פִֽיךָ׃ מִשֹּׁכֶ֣בֶת חֵיקֶ֔ךָ
verses.transliteration: ’al- ta·’ă·mî·nū ḇə·rê·a‘ ’al- tiḇ·ṭə·ḥū bə·’al·lūp̄ šə·mōr piṯ·ḥê- p̄î·ḵā miš·šō·ḵe·ḇeṯ ḥê·qe·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not rely on a friend do not trust in a companion Seal the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בֵן֙ מְנַבֵּ֣ל אָ֔ב בַּ֚ת קָמָ֣ה בְאִמָּ֔הּ כַּלָּ֖ה בַּחֲמֹתָ֑הּ אִ֖ישׁ אֹיְבֵ֥י אַנְשֵׁ֥י בֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇên mə·nab·bêl ’āḇ baṯ qā·māh ḇə·’im·māh kal·lāh ba·ḥă·mō·ṯāh ’îš ’ō·yə·ḇê ’an·šê ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: For a son dishonors his father a daughter rises against her mother and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law A man’s enemies [are] the members of his own household

verses.original: וַאֲנִי֙ אֲצַפֶּ֔ה בַּיהוָ֣ה אוֹחִ֖ילָה לֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אֱלֹהָֽי׃ יִשְׁמָעֵ֖נִי
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ă·ṣap·peh Yah·weh ’ō·w·ḥî·lāh lê·lō·hê yiš·‘î ’ĕ·lō·hāy yiš·mā·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: But as for me I will look to the LORD I will wait for the God of my salvation My God will hear me

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י לִ֔י אֹיַ֙בְתִּי֙ כִּ֥י נָפַ֖לְתִּי קָ֑מְתִּי כִּֽי־ אֵשֵׁ֣ב בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ יְהוָ֖ה א֥וֹר לִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiś·mə·ḥî lî ’ō·yaḇ·tî kî nā·p̄al·tî qā·mə·tî kî- ’ê·šêḇ ba·ḥō·šeḵ Yah·weh ’ō·wr lî
verses.literal: Do not gloat over me my enemy Though I have fallen I will arise though I sit in darkness the LORD will be my light

verses.original: כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אתִי ל֑וֹ אֶשָּׂ֔א זַ֤עַף יְהוָה֙ עַד֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֤יב רִיבִי֙ וְעָשָׂ֣ה מִשְׁפָּטִ֔י יוֹצִיאֵ֣נִי לָא֔וֹר אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּצִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lōw ’eś·śā za·‘ap̄ Yah·weh ‘aḏ ’ă·šer yā·rîḇ rî·ḇî wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pā·ṭî yō·w·ṣî·’ê·nî lā·’ō·wr ’er·’eh bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Because I have sinned against Him I must endure the rage of the LORD until - He argues my case and executes justice for me He will bring me into the light I will see His righteousness

verses.original: אֹיַ֙בְתִּי֙ וְתֵרֶ֤א וּתְכַסֶּ֣הָ בוּשָׁ֔ה הָאֹמְרָ֣ה אֵלַ֔י אַיּ֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יִךְ עֵינַי֙ תִּרְאֶ֣ינָּה בָּ֔הּ עַתָּ֛ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְמִרְמָ֖ס כְּטִ֥יט חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·yaḇ·tî wə·ṯê·re ū·ṯə·ḵas·se·hā ḇū·šāh hā·’ō·mə·rāh ’ê·lay ’ay·yōw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hā·yiḵ ‘ê·nay tir·’en·nāh bāh ‘at·tāh tih·yeh lə·mir·mās kə·ṭîṭ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame she who said to me Where is the LORD your God My eyes will see her at that time she will be trampled like mud in the streets

verses.original: י֖וֹם לִבְנ֣וֹת גְּדֵרָ֑יִךְ הַה֖וּא י֥וֹם יִרְחַק־ חֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: yō·wm liḇ·nō·wṯ gə·ḏê·rā·yiḵ ha·hū yō·wm yir·ḥaq- ḥōq
verses.literal: The day for rebuilding your walls will come the day for extending your boundary

verses.original: הוּא֙ י֥וֹם יָב֔וֹא וְעָדֶ֣יךָ לְמִנִּ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר וְעָרֵ֣י מָצ֑וֹר וּלְמִנִּ֤י מָצוֹר֙ וְעַד־ נָהָ֔ר וְיָ֥ם מִיָּ֖ם וְהַ֥ר הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hū yō·wm yā·ḇō·w wə·‘ā·ḏe·ḵā lə·min·nî ’aš·šūr wə·‘ā·rê mā·ṣō·wr ū·lə·min·nî mā·ṣō·wr wə·‘aḏ- nā·hār wə·yām mî·yām wə·har hā·hār
verses.literal: On that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt even from Egypt to the Euphrates from sea to sea and mountain to mountain

verses.original: הָאָ֛רֶץ וְהָיְתָ֥ה לִשְׁמָמָ֖ה עַל־ יֹֽשְׁבֶ֑יהָ מִפְּרִ֖י מַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh liš·mā·māh ‘al- yō·šə·ḇe·hā mip·pə·rî ma·‘al·lê·hem
verses.literal: Then the earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants as the fruit of their deeds

verses.original: רְעֵ֧ה בְשִׁבְטֶ֗ךָ עַמְּךָ֣ צֹ֚אן נַֽחֲלָתֶ֔ךָ שֹׁכְנִ֣י לְבָדָ֔ד יַ֖עַר בְּת֣וֹךְ כַּרְמֶ֑ל יִרְע֥וּ בָשָׁ֛ן וְגִלְעָ֖ד כִּימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rə·‘êh ḇə·šiḇ·ṭe·ḵā ‘am·mə·ḵā ṣōn na·ḥă·lā·ṯe·ḵā šō·ḵə·nî lə·ḇā·ḏāḏ ya·‘ar bə·ṯō·wḵ kar·mel yir·‘ū ḇā·šān wə·ḡil·‘āḏ kî·mê ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Shepherd with Your staff Your people the flock of Your inheritance They live alone in a woodland surrounded by pastures Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead as in the days of old

verses.original: כִּימֵ֥י צֵאתְךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אַרְאֶ֖נּוּ נִפְלָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kî·mê ṣê·ṯə·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’ar·’en·nū nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: As in the days when you came out vvv of Egypt I will show My wonders

verses.original: גוֹיִם֙ יִרְא֤וּ וְיֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מִכֹּ֖ל גְּבֽוּרָתָ֑ם יָשִׂ֤ימוּ יָד֙ עַל־ פֶּ֔ה אָזְנֵיהֶ֖ם תֶּחֱרַֽשְׁנָה׃
verses.transliteration: ḡō·w·yim yir·’ū wə·yê·ḇō·šū mik·kōl gə·ḇū·rā·ṯām yā·śî·mū yāḏ ‘al- peh ’ā·zə·nê·hem te·ḥĕ·raš·nāh
verses.literal: Nations will see and be ashamed deprived of all their might They will put their hands over their mouths and their ears will become deaf

verses.original: יְלַחֲכ֤וּ עָפָר֙ כַּנָּחָ֔שׁ כְּזֹחֲלֵ֣י אֶ֔רֶץ יִרְגְּז֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרֹֽתֵיהֶ֑ם אֶל־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ יִפְחָ֔דוּ וְיִֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·la·ḥă·ḵū ‘ā·p̄ār kan·nā·ḥāš kə·zō·ḥă·lê ’e·reṣ yir·gə·zū mim·mis·gə·rō·ṯê·hem ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū yip̄·ḥā·ḏū wə·yir·’ū mim·me·kā
verses.literal: They will lick the dust like a snake like reptiles slithering on the ground They will come trembling from their strongholds in the presence of the LORD our God they will tremble in fear of You

verses.original: מִי־ אֵ֣ל כָּמ֗וֹךָ נֹשֵׂ֤א עָוֺן֙ וְעֹבֵ֣ר עַל־ פֶּ֔שַׁע לִשְׁאֵרִ֖ית נַחֲלָת֑וֹ לֹא־ הֶחֱזִ֤יק אַפּ֔וֹ לָעַד֙ כִּֽי־ הֽוּא׃ חָפֵ֥ץ חֶ֖סֶד
verses.transliteration: mî- ’êl kā·mō·w·ḵā nō·śê ‘ā·wōn wə·‘ō·ḇêr ‘al- pe·ša‘ liš·’ê·rîṯ na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw lō- he·ḥĕ·zîq ’ap·pōw lā·‘aḏ kî- hū ḥā·p̄êṣ ḥe·seḏ
verses.literal: Who is a God like You who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance who does not retain His anger forever because He delights in loving devotion

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּב יְרַֽחֲמֵ֔נוּ יִכְבֹּ֖שׁ עֲוֺֽנֹתֵ֑ינוּ וְתַשְׁלִ֛יךְ כָּל־ חַטֹּאותָֽם׃ בִּמְצֻל֥וֹת יָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: yā·šūḇ yə·ra·ḥă·mê·nū yiḵ·bōš ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·nū wə·ṯaš·lîḵ kāl- ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯām bim·ṣu·lō·wṯ yām
verses.literal: He will again have compassion on us He will vanquish our iniquities You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֤ן אֱמֶת֙ לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב חֶ֖סֶד לְאַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ מִ֥ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: tit·tên ’ĕ·meṯ lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ḥe·seḏ lə·’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer- niš·ba‘·tā la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū mî·mê qe·ḏem
verses.literal: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham as You swore to our fathers from the days of old
